Full Exact Description:
Most people running Facebook Ads have no idea their biggest enemy is audience overlap.

If your ads are competing against each other, it’s not Facebook’s fault – it’s your targeting.

❌ Stacking similar interests?
❌ Running multiple ad sets for the same niche?
❌ Overloading your campaigns with retargeting?

You’re creating audience overlap.

What does that mean? Your ads are fighting for the same eyeballs in the auction, driving up costs and killing your ROAS.

Don’t believe me?

1️⃣ Go to Ads Manager.
2️⃣ Select two or more of your saved audiences.
3️⃣ Click “Show Audience Overlap.”

You’ll see how much overlap exists between your audiences – sometimes up to 100%! That’s why your ads feel inconsistent no matter how many you launch.

Want to know how to fix this and scale without wasting a single dollar?
